winner_selection_policy: PROJECT_EXECUTION.md Task 3.3 Stage 9: primary priority order doc_recall@50 > doc_mrr > doc_ndcg@10 > doc_recall@10 (identical to Task 3.2's src.eval.phase3_ablation.QUALITY_PRIORITY_KEYS); practical tie iff Recall@50 differs by <=1/89 AND paired MRR delta's 95% CI includes 0 AND paired nDCG@10 delta's 95% CI includes 0 (src.eval.phase3_ablation.is_practical_tie, reused unmodified); for practically-tied quality prefer in order: lower embedding dimension/smaller index -> faster passage embedding throughput -> lower query-embedding latency -> lower retrieval p95 -> lower peak VRAM -> smaller model artifact -> simpler/more standard integration (a new src.eval.phase3_ablation.select_round_winner tiebreak_key_fn, not the chunking-specific default). A candidate that raises Recall@50 with a credible MRR/nDCG@10 regression is flagged for a user decision, not auto-selected.
